entries.title: A reply that has to wait now says so in its thread
entries.body: When you reply under a crewmate's card and the reply cannot be answered yet, the thread now says it is saved, what it waits on - your plan's allowance, a sign-in, the checks, or the crewmate itself - and who goes next. The line changes on its own when the wait ends and goes once the crewmate answers. A message to Firstmate while it is paused now shows a saved line above the input too, even after you closed its pause card.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
